case_title: LI, CHRIS VS OGILVIE, LANI B.

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $5,000.00 FILED BY LI, CHRIS AS TO DEFENDANT OGILVIE, LANI B. ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR JUN-28-2000 AT 08:30 AM IN DEPT 506

PARTIES WAIVE SERVICE ON PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM. THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF LI, CHRIS IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT OGILVIE, LANI B. PROOF OF SERVICE WAIVED. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
